افترشنا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَرَشْنَا (iftarašnā) /if.ta.raʃ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
# اُفْتُرِشْنَا (ufturišnā) /uf.tu.riʃ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
